summary: TASK-MCP-011 represents a textbook case of severe over-engineering. A simple documentation creation task was treated as requiring 'hybrid layered intelligence' orchestration with 20 agents, multiple specialized engineers, and sophisticated validation frameworks. The actual deliverables (19 markdown files following a template) could have been created more efficiently by a single agent or even manual execution. This exemplifies the danger of applying enterprise patterns to MVP-scale problems and highlights the need for complexity validation before solution design.
